name: JM Closure & Handoff Body v0.1
purpose: Route an execution-closed serious JM build through applicable packaging, freeze, lock, anchor, mount, recovery-pointer and handoff stages without manufacturing the external/native proof those stages require.

donor_authorities.name: JM Operational Finish Freeze Lock Anchor Mount v1.0
donor_authorities.role: Existing freeze/lock/anchor/mount receipt semantics and Zionfolder/registry-anchor pattern.

rules.entry: Closure may initialize only from JM Default Execution Body state CLOSED with closure.execution_closed=true.
rules.evidence: PASS requires one or more evidence references. N/A requires an explicit reason. The closure ledger records claims and evidence references; it does not manufacture the external/native event.
rules.order: A later stage cannot resolve PASS/N/A while any earlier stage remains OPEN or FAIL.
rules.fail_closed: Any FAIL stage blocks all later closure and FORWARD_READY state until corrected and retested.
rules.package: Packaging is applicable only when the body actually has a package/artifact requirement. If not applicable, record N/A with reason rather than creating ceremony.
rules.freeze: FREEZE PASS means an external/native freeze receipt or immutable keeper evidence exists. The closure router itself cannot freeze a body.
rules.lock: LOCK PASS requires FREEZE already resolved PASS/N/A and evidence of the applicable lock mechanism.
rules.anchor: ANCHOR PASS requires prior closure stages resolved and an evidence-backed anchor/registry/branch receipt as applicable.
rules.mount: MOUNT PASS requires prior stages resolved and evidence of the applicable Zionfolder/registry/storage mount. A path string alone is not proof of mount.
rules.recovery_pointer: RECOVERY_POINTER PASS requires a concrete recoverable pointer plus evidence that it resolves to the current keeper or recovery route.
rules.handoff: HANDOFF PASS requires all earlier stages resolved and a traceable continuity handoff. It must preserve source/keeper lineage and cannot silently transfer authority by recency alone.
rules.forward: FORWARD_READY is earned only after HANDOFF PASS/N/A and no FAIL/OPEN stages remain. If FREEZE is PASS, future change must proceed as a descendant/forward body rather than mutating the frozen keeper.
rules.claim_boundary: Closure-route completion is not runtime/contact/crown proof. It also does not retroactively upgrade weaker evidence into a freeze, anchor, mount or handoff receipt.

laws: Built-ins first; never bypass a native safeguard to obtain green status.
Evidence can remove unnecessary operator repetition, but cannot substitute for a built-in that itself requires contact.
A handoff is the route through which difference gains legitimate control of continuity.
Frozen ancestors remain immutable; correct forward.
Close only what is actually proven.
